scholarly_article.headline: Finite-type invariants on free-exterior string links: low-degree restrictions and an order-seven example
scholarly_article.name: Finite-type invariants on free-exterior string links: low-degree restrictions and an order-seven example
scholarly_article.description: Low-degree restrictions and an exact order-seven invariant for ordinary rational string-link invariants on actual free exteriors.
scholarly_article.abstract: We give applications of published finite-type classification and classical genus-two symmetry to the locus of string links with free exterior group. The category is ordinary unframed smooth ordered string links with fixed boundary, upward orientation, and rational invariants. Freeness means that the actual three-dimensional exterior group is abstractly F_k. Recalling a filtered Habegger–Masbaum corollary, the intersection of the entire Milnor algebra with the two-strand order-at-most-two space is span_ℚ{1, ℓ, ℓ²}. Meilhan's classification and known free tangles give a component Conway coefficient outside the Milnor-plus-vanishing span at (k,n)=(2,2), and give zero vanishing kernel for every k ≥ 2 and 0 ≤ n ≤ 2. An exact marked genus-two reversal argument, combined with the prior Duzhin–Karev ordinary orientation detector, gives a nonzero kernel invariant of exact order seven on two strands. The seven-wheel is credited to Bar-Natan following Duzhin–Karev's journal proof. Historical priority of these combined free-exterior applications is undetermined; no firstness is claimed.
